design_description: A bold, modern football design for La Mer Noire, combining vibrant turquoise, white, and deep black. A striking diagonal white brushstroke cuts across the torso, creating a dynamic transition between the turquoise upper section and black lower half. The distressed, paint-like edges add movement and energy while maintaining a clean overall composition. Matching turquoise sleeves and a round collar complete the look, with white Momuto branding and the club crest on the chest. The back continues the same diagonal pattern, complemented by bold black player names and numbers.
